cat > /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/scripts/run_bootstrap_cuda1_retry.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1

SCRIPT_PY="scripts/clustered_bootstrap_probe.py"
OUT="results/clustered_bootstrap"

echo "[$(date)] Starting cuda:1 full TracVLA batch (trained + untrained, all suites)"

# All suites: goal, spatial, object (both conditions)
for suite in goal spatial object; do
    for cond in trained untrained; do
        OUT_DIR="${OUT}/tracvla_${suite}"
        OUT_FILE="${OUT_DIR}/${cond}.json"
        if [ -f "$OUT_FILE" ]; then
            echo "[$(date)] SKIP: tracvla_${suite}_${cond} already exists"
        else
            echo "[$(date)] === TracVLA ${suite} ${cond} ==="
            python $SCRIPT_PY --arch tracvla --suite $suite --condition $cond --gpu 0 --n_bootstrap 10000 --output_dir $OUT 2>&1 || echo "[$(date)] FAILED: tracvla_${suite}_${cond}"
        fi
    done
done

# Long suite (both conditions)
for cond in trained untrained; do
    OUT_DIR="${OUT}/tracvla_long"
    OUT_FILE="${OUT_DIR}/${cond}.json"
    if [ -f "$OUT_FILE" ]; then
        echo "[$(date)] SKIP: tracvla_long_${cond} already exists"
    else
        echo "[$(date)] === TracVLA long ${cond} ==="
        python $SCRIPT_PY --arch tracvla --suite long --condition $cond --gpu 0 --n_bootstrap 10000 --output_dir $OUT 2>&1 || echo "[$(date)] FAILED: tracvla_long_${cond}"
    fi
done

echo "[$(date)] cuda:1 full TracVLA batch complete!"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/scripts/run_bootstrap_cuda1_retry.sh
tmux kill-session -t bootstrap_cuda1 2>/dev/null; tmux new-session -d -s bootstrap_cuda1 'bash /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/scripts/run_bootstrap_cuda1_retry.sh > /tmp/bootstrap_cuda1.log 2>&1'
